subject: RE: FW: VIENNA AIRPORT - LAX / 32 PLT 163 KGS
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from MUC to DXB (Dubai, AE)? We will deliver the shipment to MUC ourselves, and it will be ready on 2026-11-29.

The shipment consists of 5 pieces of precision instruments, with a gross weight of 899.49 lb and a total volume of 75.93 cubic feet.

Please include the all-in price in EUR, the cargo acceptance cutoff at MUC, and the scheduled arrival at DXB.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-09-20
Subject: VIENNA AIRPORT - LAX / 32 PLT 163 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex VIENNA AIRPORT to LAX:
32 PLT / 163 KGS / 10.7 CBM, spare parts for packaging machines
FCA, cargo ready next week.

Thanks

classification.reasoning: The customer makes a new request for the fastest air freight option and pricing for a shipment from MUC to DXB.
